cohort: Women diagnosed with abruptio placenta admitted to King George Hospital, Visakhapatnam, between January 2023 and June 2023.
finding: The incidence of abruptio placenta was 0.6%, with 36% stillbirths, 72% maternal ICU admissions, 60% postpartum hemorrhage, and 4% each of acute kidney injury and uterine rupture, indicating poor maternal and fetal outcomes.
